column6: CompareCanonical(Name, owner) > 0 in Covers, the lower end of an NSEC's span. The two readings differ only when the name equals the owner, and neither caller can put that case in front of it. For the queried name, VerifyNSEC's NODATA loop returns before Covers is reached whenever any record owns it. For the wildcard, the very next clause asks whether a record owns that name and answers the same way in the same iteration, so the || is true either way. The guard at the other end of the span has no such cover and was killed by a test
